findings.statement: SYNTHETIC: choose a route, attempt a trial and use its damage feedback to adjust the next attempt. Clearing a trial opens the next checkpoint during that run. Checkpoints reset between runs.

applicability.notes: SYNTHETIC test-1 rules only; other coverage unknown. Pass-wide coverage: alternate route unlocks are deferred until route choice matters.

evidence.summary: The synthetic rules describe the choose-attempt-adjust loop and the checkpoint unlock and reset rules.

findings.statement: SYNTHETIC untested deduction: using a shield while learning a route may make checkpoint progress more forgiving because it reduces trial damage.

applicability.notes: SYNTHETIC test-1 rules only; other coverage unknown
